from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Metrics extracted from a single university's Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    enrollment_total: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students (Section B1)")
    class_sections: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate class sections (Section I-3)")
    faculty_count: int | None = Field(description="Total full-time instructional faculty (Section I-1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
